versions.changelog:
Initial release of world-builder (v1.0.0):

- Adds a comprehensive world-building skill supporting two modes: independent generation (from concepts) and character extraction (from Character Builder skills).
- Implements a 12-dimensional, three-layer orthogonal model (实体层, 社会层, 抽象层) to structure and fill all aspects of a fictional world.
- Integrates with meta-skill-system pipeline, including three-axis evaluation, domain calibration, workflow orchestration, and fallback modes.
- Provides robust input parsing, task routing, and strict fact/modeling rules to ensure consistency and logical coherence.
- Supports partial/worldwide generation, prompt export, and downgrade modes for offline or limited-interaction scenarios.
